title: How is everyone doing 3D clothing fitting without clipping?
author: Cheedows
selftext:
Been struggling with this for the past week, trying to find a way to have my clothing in a 3D game layer properly and be fitted to my characters and races without any clipping. Going to be honest it's been a struggle, even with models with 3D capabilities like Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5. Thinking there's surely something I'm missing and it's a solved problem but regardless of method or algorithm it all turns out to be a mess.

Especially with things like cloaks or coats, or skirts and dresses, anything that extends past the torso and it's a disaster. Wondering if anyone else has had much luck getting this to work and what's your workflow?
